content.text: The Full List With Context

The top 7 options for Bangladeshi freelancers to accept international payments include blockchain-based solutions like NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. Other alternatives involve utilizing Cloudflare infrastructure for secure and efficient transactions. Each option has its strengths and weaknesses, and understanding these nuances is crucial for making an informed decision. The list includes a mix of established players and innovative newcomers, all of which offer a degree of sovereignty and flexibility. By examining each option in context, freelancers can begin to build a comprehensive strategy for accepting international payments.
Why Each Item on This List Matters

Each option on the list matters because it addresses a specific pain point or requirement for Bangladeshi freelancers. For instance, some solutions prioritize security and compliance, while others focus on ease of use and low transaction fees. By considering these factors, freelancers can choose the best fit for their business needs and goals. Moreover, the diversity of options ensures that there is a solution for every type of freelancer, regardless of their size, industry, or target market. This variety is essential for promoting healthy competition and driving innovation in the commerce infrastructure space.
The Ones Most Creators Get Wrong

Many creators mistakenly believe that they need to compromise on sovereignty or security when choosing a payment solution. However, this is not necessarily the case. By prioritizing infrastructure sovereignty, freelancers can maintain control over their transactions and data, while also ensuring the integrity of their business operations. Additionally, some creators overlook the importance of scalability and flexibility when selecting a payment solution. As their business grows, they may find that their initial choice is no longer suitable, leading to costly migrations or workarounds. By choosing a solution that can adapt to their evolving needs, freelancers can avoid these pitfalls and focus on driving growth.
Prioritize infrastructure sovereignty to maintain control over transactions and data.
How to Prioritise What to Implement First

To prioritize which payment solution to implement first, freelancers should assess their immediate needs and goals. They should consider factors such as transaction volume, target market, and revenue projections. By evaluating these factors, they can identify the most critical requirements for their business and choose a solution that meets those needs. Additionally, freelancers should consider the ease of integration and the level of support offered by each solution. By prioritizing these factors, they can ensure a smooth and successful implementation, while also setting themselves up for long-term success.
Putting the List Into a Deployable Stack

By combining multiple payment solutions into a deployable stack, freelancers can create a robust and resilient commerce infrastructure. This approach allows them to leverage the strengths of each solution, while also mitigating their weaknesses. For example, they might use NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, while also integrating Cloudflare infrastructure for secure and efficient processing. By deploying a comprehensive stack, freelancers can ensure that their business is well-equipped to handle a wide range of payment scenarios, from small transactions to large-scale enterprise deals.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.

Your Deployment Checklist

Open a self-custody wallet — Trust Wallet or MetaMask — and back up the seed phrase before configuring anything else. Create your NOWPayments account and configure the self-custody wallet addresses as your payout destination. Open a Binance account and complete enough P2P setup to verify you can convert USDT to your local currency. Deploy your stack and configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint. Build your product pages with USD prices and confirm the checkout generates QR codes and live price feeds correctly. Run a mainnet test transaction from a second wallet to confirm the full pipeline. Do a test P2P conversion with a small amount of USDT to confirm the conversion process works end-to-end. Promote your store.
